criteria.name: Thumb-stop cover
criteria.notes: Judged at 432 first. 'The permit can find the robot. / It can't count the seal.' sets in exactly two lines at 118px Fraunces, 11 words, a named tension rather than a topic label, and the UND dial is legible as a dial with a printed scale and no needle at thumb size. Visibly Arctic without cliche: lit ice crust with keels and brine channels across the top band, dark header type on it (measured, 1.7 and 1.0 rejected on the prototype), 'BEAUFORT AND CHUKCHI, YEAR 9' naming place and term. Against 10: the cover carries no NUMBER, and the deck's sharpest asset is a number pair (39,258 against UND) held back to slide 07; and the focal point genuinely competes, with the gold fix upper right, the dial lower right and a black riser cable crossing the right third, three marks on one diagonal rather than one. The mid-left band under the headline is the frame's least worked region.

criteria.name: Story arc & swipe momentum
criteria.notes: Real beat structure, not a list wearing story clothes: 02 pays the cover off immediately with the mechanism in the notice's own words, 05 CONCEDES precisely (all four mitigation radii drawn to true scale) which is what earns 07's blank as an argument rather than a complaint, 06 turns the temperature cold, 08 states what the record actually is, 09 asks one thing. The contact sheet reads as one composed descent because D4 is visible in the bytes: each frame's water top is the previous frame's bed, ramping #1A4C57 to #030A10 across nine frames. Loops plant and pay. Deductions: slide 06 opens on a data label, 'THE 22 DAYS ABOARD' at y~240, sitting ABOVE its own kicker 'WHAT RUNS AFTER / THE SHIP GOES HOME' at y~320, so the frame's first read is an annotation. That is verbatim the defect ROUND 2 found and fixed on slide 03 ('The buoy label sat above the kicker and read as the frame's opening line') and it is left standing here. 03 and 04 are the two frames reorderable without loss.

criteria.name: Artwork craft & genuine detail
criteria.notes: Credited because I can see them, not because they are described: the plate feather no longer reads as a rectangle (slide 02's four label containers are soft basins in the interference field, and I looked for the hard edge specifically); slide 03's eight bodies carry two-strip value ladders keyed to AKICE.contrast and body 4's ray fan opens into the quiet quadrant; slide 06's unattended ticks now survive the 5x downsample so the lit band has a denominator to be a fraction of; slide 03's gold source ticks EXIST (the first build shipped zero gold pixels) and are marks at a position, not lengths; slide 08's contact reads attached, pool opposite the lee with the seam running the whole base line; slide 01's phantom rim survives the bezel profile all the way round; slide 04's aurora glider sits exactly on its own 1,000m tick with a real gold arc dissolving at both ends. Line-weight hierarchy is genuine and one declared key (az 12 el 62) holds on all nine. Against 8 and up: THE HERO STAYED FLAT AND THE DOSSIER NEVER ARGUES IT. No akthree GPU PBR, no aksdf raymarch, no film-graded rendered hero anywhere; the storyboard argues the 2D chassis on collision-safety grounds and never addresses the ladder. That is the 7 descriptor word for word. Dead zones remain and are large: slide 04's lower-left and slide 08's upper-right are each roughly a quarter frame of near-uniform black carrying a handful of stars; slide 06's left column below the body is bare. Slide 04 ships a ~40px white stub above the glider's back that terminates in open water and reads as a stray mark. Slide 06's gold band stops ~90px short of the grey field's right edge, so the one frame whose entire argument is a ratio of counts has a lit band whose row width does not match the rows it is a fraction of. Slide 05 is four cool circles, a cross and a mote field, and at 432 it is the thinnest-inked frame in the deck.

criteria.name: Story-art fusion
criteria.notes: Art parameters visibly encode story numbers in four places and the frames say so. Slide 05 draws 457/183/55/15 at true relative radius on the slide's own 0.90 px-per-metre mapping and prints 'ALL FOUR RADII ARE THE NOTICE'S. THE SCALE IS THIS PAGE'S'. Slide 06 encodes 22 days of a year as 132 lit ticks in 2,190 and prints neither derived product. Slide 04's mote count IS 639,237 at one mote per 100 km2. Slide 07's ring radius IS the coefficient of variation and the frame prints exactly that disclaimer, so the two beluga rings differ by measured uncertainty while the third dial's socket is empty. The colour law (gold is what the record knows, #7D8F94 is what it does not) is auditable against one sentence, and the run counted the pixels per frame rather than asserting it. A stranger could guess the story from slide 07 alone. Deduction: slide 03's hedge is drawn on the body numbered 8. Eight bodies are six moorings plus two buoys, so the phantom-dashed one reading as the EIGHTH source reads as an uncertain buoy, when the hedge belongs to the sixth mooring and C15 carries no hedge. It is the one place the art contradicts the text it is encoding. Slides 01 and 08 carry no verified quantity as a drawn length and sit closer to illustration.

criteria.name: Alaska authenticity & local relevance
criteria.notes: Named throughout and geographically careful: Beaufort and Chukchi, NMFS, Office of Naval Research, 91 FR 57547, Beaufort beluga, Eastern Chukchi beluga, Arctic ringed seal as the one species here listed as threatened, the Canadian EEZ, 204 kilometres to the Alaska coast, the September 13th 2022 Biological Opinion, three comment letters all from private citizens. The best authenticity call in the deck is a refusal: for water 110 nautical miles offshore the deck draws NO coastline and types the 204 km instead, so it never fakes a geography it cannot verify (slide 04's acceptance test is 'The Alaska coast is not drawn anywhere'). Deduction: the fact-checker rightly killed the Inupiat co-management framing and nothing replaced it, so there is no Alaskan person and no Alaskan community in nine frames. The ringed seal is a subsistence animal and the deck never says who depends on it. This would make a Federal Register reader feel seen; an Alaskan is one beat further away than the 10 descriptor asks.

criteria.name: Insight density & factual weight
criteria.notes: Every content slide adds a new verified specific and none repeats another's: 02 the trilateration mechanism in the notice's words; 03 900-950 Hz, 30 s, every 4 h, NTE 185 dB re 1 uPa at 1 m; 04 639,237 km2, 204 km / 110 nm, three jurisdictions including Canada's; 05 four radii plus 'Level A harassment neither anticipated nor authorized'; 06 22 days from September 22nd, transmission to September 13th 2027, the observer clause, ice strengthened rather than icebreaking; 07 39,258 from 1992, 13,305 from 2017 at CV 0.51, UND; 08 September 14th, the statutory one-year ceiling, the ninth year, the 2022 BiOp, three comment letters. Bodies run 24 to 48 words, inside band, zero filler. The honesty architecture is better than the rubric asks for: aggregate_check forced NINE YEARS to THE NINTH YEAR because C06 does not print the number, and it forced a kicker rewrite because the notice never says 'three' distances. Deductions: slide 05's body and its own clarification line both explain the 55 metre zone, the deck's one repeated beat on one frame; slide 02 carries a single verified figure.

Dials declared with a stated reason. criteria.name: Legibility & platform fitness
criteria.notes: Floors met: body 32-34px (slide 05's lower band is exactly 32 and not below), no string under 24px except the licensed 18px watermark, counters on all nine, margins held, vector PDF 8.48 MB with title. The thing this round set out to earn IS earned: at 432 I read every headline, every body paragraph and most mono labels on all nine thumbs without zooming, and slide 05 in particular now reads as two columns. Three squeakers, which is why this is a 7 and not an 8. (1) Slide 07's 'NO VALUE TO PLOT' overlaps dial three's lit navy face with its first two glyphs, where that grey drops to roughly 4.4:1, the deck's worst measured point, fixable by moving the label 40px right into clear ground. (2) Slide 05's 457m dimension call terminates correctly on the 457 arc but at ~(795,1712), inside the bounding box of the clarification's last line: the new AKFIT.guard check compares [data-reserve] boxes to each other and qa checks a leader against its TARGET, so a leader terminator versus a text box is still ungated, and this is the surviving cousin of the defect that produced the 6.9. (3) Slide 06's 'ONE TICK, ONE 30 s PULSE' sits ~30 design px under the body's last line and reads as the paragraph's next sentence.

criteria.name: Copy: voice & hook
criteria.notes: Hook 109 chars, inside 140, and it is a claim rather than a tease: 'Two numbers and one blank sit in the stock table of the Arctic permit NMFS issued the Navy on September 10th.' 825 chars, inside 300-900. The analytical position is taken plainly and in the house register: 'The machine half is exact to the second. The animal half is stale or blank.' Deck-summary line present. The closing question is genuinely debatable and not rhetorical: 'How does the seal's blank survive nine years of one year permits?' 0.65 commas per 100 words against a 1.05 budget; three hashtags; no link in body; first comment is four primary URLs with a dated citation block and an invitation to people who have worked these stocks. Grade reads about 9. One soft line: the deck-summary beat describes the artifact ('Nine frames descend one column of water') where the third punch should land.

criteria.name: Deliverable completeness
criteria.notes: Everything material is present and resolves: copy.json with nine slides plus first_comment plus deck_summary plus a four-item aftercare checklist; exactly three hashtags; document title carried into the PDF from copy.json; vector PDF 8.48 MB; nine thumbs plus contact sheet in runs/2026-09-12/; assemble_report with sha256 and byte counts for all nine PNGs and all nine HTML; claims.json, caption_report, aggregate_report, machine_qa all parse; site_fresh PASS (docs/ exactly a fresh build at --date 2026-09-12, 184 files); site_signoff 18/18; GATE STATUS synced by script and not hand-written. The deduction is specific and it is the one thing this round claimed to have learned: the BUILD RECONCILIATION table, which the run itself names as the mechanism by which the last hard fail survived six rooms, STILL CONTAINS TWO ROWS THAT MISDESCRIBE THE RENDER. Row 01 reads 'Nothing. Built as planned.' while the dossier's layout map places the dial lower left at [330,980] and the render puts it lower right, a divergence the ROUND 2 section defends as a refused finding three pages later. Row 02 reads 'Kicker is the dossier's 41 character string' while the shipped kicker is 'POSITION BY DISTANCE, IN THE NOTICE'S WORDS' and copy.json's own note records that string being replaced twice. Slide 05's row was fixed and honestly says it was wrong; its two siblings were never looked for. Separately the dossiers' section-A 'COPY, final' blocks are stale against copy.json on 02, 03, 04, 05, 06 and 07, and copy.json still declares 3-line headline breaks for 07 and 09 that the fitter set in 2, including the exact orphan ('number.') that ROUND 2 says it fixed. None of this reaches a reader and every gate that matters reads copy.json, which is correct, so this is a convenience element rough rather than a missing component.

editor_notes_for_email: ZERO HARD FAILS. The 6.9 cap is lifted and the fix is visible, not merely described: on slide-05.png the widest zone label clears the prose column by ~42 design px where it had 9, and I confirmed it at 432 before going full size. Weighted 8.72 against 8.3 (the rubric ladder would allow 8.0 at round 3, so it clears either bar). SHIP. Four things to know before posting. (1) The three refused critic findings are still all three sound and I say so again independently: not moving slide 01's dial is right because the render is the artifact and the frame balances headline-left against instrument-right; not resetting slide 04's window is right because C27 puts the glider's transit floor at 1,000 m and the acceptance test is the glider on that tick, so moving the mapping's bottom to y 1040 was the correct repair; and refusing CV-times-value on slide 07 is the strongest of the three, because a frame may not print 'RING RADIUS IS A COEFFICIENT OF VARIATION, NOT A DISTANCE' and then draw something else. (2) The reconciliation lesson is NOT fully learned. Rows 01 and 02 of BUILD RECONCILIATION still misdescribe the render (row 01 says 'Nothing. Built as planned.' about a frame whose dial position the run deliberately refused to move; row 02 names a kicker copy.json's own note says was replaced twice). Nothing reaches a reader, but this belongs in FIELD_NOTES as a recurrence, and the real machine lesson is that the new AKFIT.guard check compares reserve box to reserve box while qa checks a leader against its target, so a leader TERMINATOR versus a TEXT BOX is still ungated. Slide 05's 457 m arrowhead lands at ~(795,1712), inside the last line of the clarification paragraph: that is the surviving cousin of the defect that cost the 6.9, and it is the gate to write next. (3) Lane saturation, flag only, not a repeat: this is the third Arctic marine acoustics and marine mammal deck in fourteen days (No.44 the Chukchi glider call library, No.52 fisheries survey monitoring, No.57 today). I read No.44 in full and agree with the run's dedupe call, since there is zero entity overlap and it is a different agency, document class and decision, but a fourth in this lane would not survive. (4) Two cosmetic defects a sharp commenter could name: slide 07's 'NO VALUE TO PLOT' has its first two glyphs on dial three's navy face at roughly 4.4:1, the deck's worst measured point, and slide 04 carries a ~40px white stub above the glider that terminates in open water. Also worth a glance but not this run's to fix: gate_status shows gas_watch WARN with 1 day missing from a 37-day series, first 2026-09-08, and cron owns that collector. Finally, honour aftercare item 3 in the comments: if anyone asks how many animals may be harassed, the answer is that no take number is in the reachable record and four fetch routes failed to find one. Post Tuesday to Thursday, 8 to 11am Alaska time, and paste the first comment block within 60 seconds so the raw URLs stay clickable.
